Extremely confusing and wasteful experience.. I was really excited to try Make AI Veo 3 because the video quality and promise of cinematic AI generation looked amazing. But the actual user experience was incredibly frustrating and misleading.

I ended up burning through all my credits just entering prompts! without realizing that each prompt submission was already charging me, even if I didn’t generate a final video!! There’s no clear warning, no confirmation step, and no obvious feedback that a video is being processed. I thought the app wasn’t working, so I tried again… and again… until all my credits were gone and I had nothing to show for it.

This is not beginner-friendly, and it feels like a trap for users who are just trying to learn the system. There should be clear labeling, confirmation dialogs, and a real chance to preview or retry without being punished.

Until the interface is fixed and better safeguards are in place, I can’t recommend this at all. If you value your credits or time, stay far away or prepare to be disappointed.
